text:
Sarah (finance): Hey team — ACME (acme-corp) dispute: Invoice INV-2024-0412 shows 12h of burst/overage on their Dedicated commit for Apr. Customer insists they never went above commit. Can platform confirm what triggered the autoscale?

Mike (platform): Looking at autoscaler and node logs — we show spikes that caused 3 extra nodes to spin up between 2024-04-10T03:10Z and 2024-04-10T15:10Z. Extract:
```
2024-04-10T03:12Z scale up +3 nodes reason=cpu_p99>threshold
2024-04-10T15:08Z scale down -3 nodes
```
Those intervals sum to ~12 node-hours. Link to full logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/agg/ACME/2024-04-10

Raj (customer-success): Customer says they were running a scheduled export job around 03:00Z but it should have been within the reserved commit. Their commit_id is RC-9832 (reserved 4 nodes baseline).

Mike (platform): Commit RC-9832 sets baseline 4 nodes; autoscaling policy allowed burst beyond that and we billed overage per contract. Overage calc: 12 node-hours * $150/node-hour = $1,800.

Sarah (finance): Also note there was an incident on 2024-04-09 causing degraded performance (INC-2024-178). Customer is eligible for SLA credit per SLA section 4.2. I need numbers to propose offset.

Olivia (sales): ACME is annual enterprise customer. I'd prefer we avoid a billing fight — happy to offer a credit if finance approves.

Mike (platform): SLA credit calc: outage impacted 2 full hours of throughput, per SLA that's 10% of monthly Dedicated fee. Their monthly committed fee = $5,000 => credit = $500.

Sarah (finance): Proposal: apply SLA credit of $500 to invoice INV-2024-0412 and waive remaining disputed overage if net cost to us <= $1,300, but need approval from Tom. @tom can you sign off on issuing $500 credit and covering remaining overage write-down of $800 as one-time goodwill?

Tom (finance-lead): Approve $500 SLA credit. I do not approve full write-down. Let's split: we issue $500 credit and offer 50% off the remaining overage as a one-time concession. That would make customer net overage = $650. Approve?

Olivia (sales): ACME will accept that. I can send amended invoice and note concession in CRM.

Sarah (finance): OK I'll generate amended invoice INV-2024-0412-A: original charges overage $1,800 - $500 SLA credit - $650 concession = $650 due. Will update accounting and billing system.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0412-A generated and queued for sending to billing@acme.com (actionId=ci-778).

Raj (customer-success): I'll follow up with ACME to close the loop. Thanks everyone :tada:
